MeteoGalicia station inventory (data.frame)

Source: R/meteogal2inventory.R
meteogal2inventory.Rd

Station identifiers, names, municipality, province, altitude and geographical coordinates, as a base R data.frame. By default the station list service of MeteoGalicia is queried (listaEstacionsMeteo.action); alternatively, data_dir derives the inventory from local observations, including stations no longer active.

Usage

meteogal2inventory(file = NULL, data_dir = NULL, verbose = FALSE, timeout = 60)

Arguments

file

NULL, or a destination .rds, .rda/.RData or .csv path.

data_dir

NULL (query the service) or a directory/file of observations readable by meteogal2df().

verbose

Show progress messages.

timeout

Seconds allowed for the online request.

Value

Invisibly, a data.frame with station_id, station_name, municipality, province, altitude (m), lon, lat, first_date and last_date.

Details

The online service lists the stations currently in service; it is not a historical inventory. With data_dir, first_date and last_date are the first and last dates present in the local data, not official opening/closing dates. Coordinates are WGS84 decimal degrees (lon, lat) and altitude is in metres. Data source: MeteoGalicia, Xunta de Galicia.

References

MeteoGalicia station list (JSON): https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/rss/JSON_listaEstacionsMeteo_es.pdf; station fields are also described in https://www.meteogalicia.gal/datosred/infoweb/meteo/docs/rss/JSON_estado_actual_es.pdf.

See also

meteogal2df(), meteogal2lfdata()

Examples

f <- system.file("extdata", "meteogal_small.csv", package = "meteogal2fdata")
meteogal2inventory(data_dir = f)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inv <- meteogal2inventory(file = "meteogal_inventory.rds")
plot(inv$lon, inv$lat, asp = 1, pch = 19)
} # }
